answer: A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a swarm in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, since every identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The falcon cap is enforced at intake and trellis makes public the per-origin counts. At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a vertex tag. That is 13 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
